visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white camisole and black pants, sits on a grey couch holding a tan Cocker Spaniel. The environment is a minimalist studio with a grey wall background and bright studio lighting. She gestures with her hands as she speaks to the camera. (2) Close-up of the dog resting its head on the couch, its eyes partially closed. The woman's hand is seen petting its side. The dog has visible age-related cloudiness in its eyes. (3) Transition to an indoor home setting with tiled floors. The dog is seen walking while wearing a large orange paper bucket over its head, navigating near a doorway. (4) Montage showing the woman kissing the dog while it sleeps on a sofa. Another shot shows the dog wearing a colorful polka-dot party hat next to a small cake with two lit candles. (5) Back in the studio, the woman continues speaking, using various hand motions to count or emphasize. High-contrast text boxes occasionally appear over the center of the frame. (6) A brief outdoor shot shows the dog walking on a grey paved walkway with a metal fence and urban buildings in the background under cloudy skies. (7) The video concludes with static logos for the Ministry of Agriculture and TAIWAN SPCA on a clean white background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Hi 大家好 我是 Sandy. (2) [Subtitle]: 這是我的 王子天使卡卡. (3) [Slogan]: 卡卡一個月的花費 大概是多少錢. (4) [Subtitle]: 大概是 2萬起跳. (5) [Variety]: 每天必吸100次. (6) [Slogan]: 人有健保 那毛小孩呢. (7) [Subtitle]: 狗狗看醫生 基本掛號費 應該就是800吧. (8) [Slogan]: 有什麼想跟 新手爸媽說的. (9) [Subtitle]: 狗狗給你情緒價值 給你愛. (10) [Logo]: TAIWAN SPCA.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins with a warm, welcoming tone and moderate pitch, introducing herself and the dog. A soft acoustic guitar BGM with a light, steady rhythm plays in the background at 105 BPM. (2) A male voice briefly asks a question from off-camera. The female speaker continues with a calm, informative tone, discussing monthly expenses. The guitar BGM persists, maintaining a gentle atmosphere. (3) The female voice shifts to a slightly more serious, empathic tone while describing medical costs. Minor fabric rustling from her movements is heard. (4) High-pitched bell-like SFX accentuates the appearance of text on screen. The vocal intensity remains consistent and professional. (5) The speaker's tone becomes more encouraging and instructional as she shares advice for pet owners. The BGM maintains its major-key, uplifting mood throughout the transition. (6) Final closing remarks are delivered with a friendly rising intonation. The BGM and vocals fade out together over the final second.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Intro -> Expense Inquiry -> Medical Discussion -> Responsibility Advice -> Emotional Value -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational and emotional PSA promoting responsible pet ownership by detailing the high financial and emotional costs associated with caring for an elderly dog, specifically supported by the Taiwan SPCA.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Appearance of SPCA and Ministry of Agriculture logos at the end and discussion centered on animal welfare advocacy.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video blends personal vlog aesthetics with formal public service advocacy, utilizing the creator's personal bond with her dog to deliver a serious message about pet care commitments.
